# Error codes and exit codes

<!-- generated by scripts/gen_errors_md.py, do not edit -->

This file is generated by `scripts/gen_errors_md.py` from `src/brandcal/errors.py`. Do not edit it; change the docstring there and run `python scripts/gen_errors_md.py`.

Exit 0 is success and exit 1 is never used deliberately (it means an unexpected crash).

| Exit | Code | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 2 | `BAD_ARGS` | The command line could not be understood. |
| 2 | `HOME_NOT_CONFIGURED` | No data directory is configured (BRANDCAL_HOME or --home). |
| 2 | `NO_AGENT` | No acting agent given (--as or BRANDCAL_AGENT), or the agent is unknown. |
| 2 | `TZ_NOT_CONFIGURED` | No display timezone is configured (config.json "timezone" or BRANDCAL_TZ). |
| 3 | `BAD_TIME` | A date or time could not be parsed. |
| 3 | `BAD_WINDOW` | A time window is not a valid ISO 8601 interval within one local date. |
| 3 | `INVALID_POST` | The post's structure breaks a rule (part count, target URL, article title or body). |
| 3 | `MEDIA_INVALID` | A media file failed its checks (type, size, alt text, count). |
| 3 | `ON_HOLD` | The post has a hold that has not been cleared. |
| 3 | `TIME_OFFSET_REQUIRED` | A timestamp was given without an explicit UTC offset. |
| 3 | `TOO_LONG` | A part's text is over the platform's character limit. |
| 4 | `COMMENT_NOT_DELEGATED` | Agents never post comments unless a human has delegated that exact comment. |
| 4 | `ROLE_NOT_ALLOWED` | The acting agent's role may not do this. |
| 5 | `APPEND_ONLY` | Events and approvals are never changed, and deleted only by an archive run. |
| 5 | `BAD_TRANSITION` | This status change is not in the state machine (SPEC 6.1). |
| 5 | `EDIT_WHILE_CLAIMED` | Edits are refused while the post is claimed for publishing. |
| 5 | `EDIT_WHILE_SCHEDULED` | Content or window edits are refused while the post is natively scheduled. |
| 5 | `NATIVELY_SCHEDULED` | The post is queued in the platform's own scheduler; unschedule it first. |
| 5 | `NO_FRESH_BACKUP` | No verified backup exists for the required period. |
| 5 | `POST_CLOSED` | The post is published or cancelled and can no longer be changed. |
| 6 | `HASH_MISMATCH` | The content hash given, or recomputed from the files, does not match the post. |
| 6 | `STALE_APPROVAL` | No approval matches the post's current content version and hash. |
| 6 | `WINDOW_NOT_APPROVED` | The post's time window is not inside the window the approver agreed to. |
| 7 | `ARCHIVED` | The post was moved to a monthly archive file; read it with archive show. |
| 7 | `NOT_FOUND` | No such post in the live calendar. |
| 8 | `CHECK_LIVE_FIRST` | A previous claim expired; confirm the post is not already live first. |
| 8 | `CLAIMED` | The post is claimed for publishing by a manager. |
| 8 | `URL_CONFLICT` | The post is already published with a different URL. |
